noveltyJustification: First security pass of the session: strategy listed security as untouched, so all three findings are new and none refines a prior one.

graphEvents.label: HAR and cookie artifacts have no secret boundary
redaction rule scoped to undefined 'default logs'

reviewDepthApplicability.reason: Five vendored packets, the hub authority files and the vendor sync engine were in scope; secret handling spans config, skill bodies, references and the ignore boundary.

targetSelection.selectionReason: Dispatch named committed config, private-material boundaries, browser automation and the vendor-sync write path as this pass's security focus.
omittedHighRiskTargets: AI Systems/Product Owner/claude project/local/ (untracked private file, presence and ignore status only)

searchLedger.invariant: A packet that teaches exporting secret-bearing artifacts must state a redaction rule and must have an ignore boundary for the artifact.
searchLedger.rationale: Recipe writes output.har into cwd; no packet, hub or ignore rule governs it.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Committed runtime config embeds a live credential.
searchLedger.ruledOutReason: No literal credential in any tracked runtime config; credential references are ${VAR} placeholders.
searchLedger.rationale: verified by direct read of each file

searchLedger.hypothesis: A gitignored secret file was committed before the rule and survives in the index.

searchActions.result: no index hit for any of the three; ignore rules .gitignore:10, :16, :15

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: None of the private files appears in git ls-files, so no pre-ignore commit exists.

searchLedger.hypothesis: Bare FIGMA_API_KEY versus prefixed figma_FIGMA_API_KEY is an unresolved credential-naming split.

searchActions.result: mapping table and troubleshooting entry document the pairing

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Deliberate and documented in four places.

searchLedger.invariant: A redaction rule must name the artifact classes it governs, and one rule must not be weaker than the leaf that restates it.
searchLedger.rationale: Skill body permits saved evidence that its catalog leaf forbids.

searchLedger.hypothesis: A manifest path can escape its root through the local or upstream join.

searchActions.result: contained_path refuses .., absolute, backslash; local_dir resolve-checked and refused when equal to root

searchLedger.ruledOutReason: Spelling guard plus resolved containment on the written tree; the docstring's claim holds for the manifest value.
searchLedger.rationale: traversal ruled out; the residual root-trust gap is filed separately as R3-P2-003

searchLedger.hypothesis: The upstream-root override is trusted more than the discovered root.

searchActions.result: override returns Path(override); discovery branch resolves candidates

searchLedger.rationale: Validation asymmetry on a whole-tree write path.

searchActions.queryOrPath: subprocess / os.system on the write path

searchLedger.deferredReason: No subprocess or os.system search was run; budget was spent on the secret surface. The functions read use shutil/pathlib only, which is suggestive but not a search result.

searchLedger.hypothesis: The context/ negation pair keeps .gitkeep and README tracked as the rule claims.

searchActions.result: pattern required a leading slash, so a repo-relative match was impossible

searchLedger.deferredReason: The check itself was malformed; re-run as `git ls-files context` next iteration.
